_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "homes" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EUR', "hemisphere" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'north', "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rooms" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "paint_colour" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "paint_brand" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "paint_reference" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "paint_batch" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "floor_covering" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "wall_covering" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "memory_notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "paint_article_id" BLOB NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "room_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'equipment', "brand" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "model" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "serial_number" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "installed_on" TEXT NULL, "warranty_ends_on" TEXT NULL, "purchased_on" TEXT NULL, "warranty_duration" INTEGER NULL, "warranty_duration_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'year', "warranty_provider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "warranty_provider_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "warranty_starts_on" TEXT NULL, "contract_contractor_id" BLOB NULL, "contract_number" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "contract_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "links" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photos" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "room_id" BLOB NULL, "item_id" BLOB NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', "caption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "image" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contractors" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "trade" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "trade_other" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "email" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_id" BLOB NULL, "item_id" BLOB NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "procedure" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "contractor_id" BLOB NULL, "repeat_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'once', "repeat_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'month', "repeat_interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "season" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "season_start_month" INTEGER NULL, "season_end_month" INTEGER NULL, "hide_days_before" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "series_start" TEXT NULL, "material_budget" TEXT NULL, "labour_budget" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "occurrences" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "task_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "due_on" TEXT NULL, "visible_from" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', "status_before" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "postponed_from" TEXT NULL, "completed_on" TEXT NULL, "completion_note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "follows" BLOB NULL, "actual_cost" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "articles" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "manufacturer_reference" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "dimensions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "storage_location" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "unit_other" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "threshold" TEXT NULL, "unit_price" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "article_rooms" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "article_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "room_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "article_items" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "article_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "item_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "article_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "last_price" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movements" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "article_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "occurrence_id" BLOB NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_materials" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "task_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "article_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "quantity" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "material_draws" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "article_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "wanted" TEXT NOT NULL, "drawn" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idea', "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "season" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "season_start_month" INTEGER NULL, "season_end_month" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_rooms" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "project_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "room_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_lines" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "project_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "nature" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "planned" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00', "paid" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quotes" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "project_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "contractor_id" BLOB NULL, "amount" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00', "issued_on" TEXT NULL, "valid_until" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested', "budget_line_id" BLOB NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_files" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "project_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "quote_id" BLOB NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "file" TEXT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_image" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_image" IN (0, 1)), "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_links" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "project_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "project_tasks" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "project_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "task_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "annual_envelopes" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reports" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "room_id" BLOB NULL, "item_id" BLOB NULL, "article_id" BLOB NULL, "place" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "task_id" BLOB NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "photo" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "field_clock" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity", "row_id", "field"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "op_log" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "device" BLOB NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" BLOB NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "extra" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "home_id" BLOB NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity", "row_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" BLOB NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purged_homes" ("home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("home_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "other_versions" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "home_id" BLOB NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device" BLOB NOT NULL, "kept_until" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity", "row_id", "field", "hlc", "device"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "server_seen" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity", "row_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_sync" ("file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "holder" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("file_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_attachments" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "home_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "task_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "occurrence_id" BLOB NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "file" TEXT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_image" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_image" IN (0, 1)), "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX room_home_position ON rooms (home_id, position)
CREATE INDEX task_home_created ON tasks (home_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX occ_home_status_due ON occurrences (home_id, status, due_on)
CREATE INDEX occ_task_status ON occurrences (task_id, status)
CREATE INDEX article_home_name ON articles (home_id, name)
CREATE INDEX movement_article ON movements (article_id)
CREATE INDEX material_task ON task_materials (task_id)
CREATE INDEX draw_occurrence ON material_draws (occurrence_id)
CREATE INDEX project_home_status ON projects (home_id, status)
CREATE INDEX line_project ON budget_lines (project_id)
CREATE INDEX quote_project ON quotes (project_id)
CREATE INDEX report_home_status ON reports (home_id, status)
CREATE INDEX attachment_task ON task_attachments (task_id)
